# RasQberry Two reference

These pages are generated from the RasQberry Two code (development branch) by `docs/reference/reference_docs.py`, so they say what the Pi actually does. They are a reference for advanced users and the knowledge of the RasQberry helpers; the user guide is rasqberry.org. Rebuild them after a change with `python3 docs/reference/reference_docs.py`; a unit test fails while they are out of date.

- [The RasQberry menu](menu.md): every menu and entry of the RasQberry menu in raspi-config.
- [The desktop](desktop.md): icons, group windows, the taskbar and what starts at login.
- [Demos](demos.md): every demo, what it needs and how to start it.
- [Settings](settings.md): every setting with its default, and which survive updates.
- [Commands](commands.md): the terminal commands for people.
